_about: The pollution map (home page) and Cleaner route (plan page). Each can be turned off with the settings air_map and clean_route (SAM parameters AirMap and CleanRoute).
_bounds_about: Stations are read inside this box around the map centre (degrees each way).
_style_about: The base map: Amazon Location Service when its API key is set up, else the open tiles below.

text.title: Air across Delhi right now
text.lead: Each dot is a monitoring station, coloured by its AQI.
text.failed: The station readings cannot be reached right now.
text.model: Forecast for each area (no live stations right now)

route._about: Cleaner route: Amazon Location Service finds up to max_alternatives other routes; the air along each comes from the nearest station to points every sample_km. The pick is the route with the least pollution breathed (average AQI times minutes on the way).

text.title: A cleaner way today
text.lead: Take route {n}: {pct}% less pollution than your usual way (average AQI {aqi} instead of {usual}).
text.title_compare: Your routes and their air today
text.fine: No need to switch today: your usual way's average AQI is {usual}.

route._always_show_about: true: every trip shows its routes and their air; "Take route N" still waits for suggest_above_aqi. false: the panel shows only when a better path is suggested.
route._suggest_about: The better path shows only when the usual route's average AQI is above suggest_above_aqi (150 = well into Moderate) and another route cuts the pollution breathed by at least suggest_min_pct.
